name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2062: Three things could delete his footage and each had its own idea of safe. The prune kept a frame only when it LOOKED different from the one before, and a hover tooltip - the only place D2R writes an item name - moves that number by zero, which is why v2058 had to turn it off. frame_authority.py asks the question that actually decides it: IS THIS FRAME EVIDENCE. A frame is offered only when its recording is SEALED, it is not named as a witness behind a vault row, and it is not among the newest five; anything unreadable holds everything. Measured on his real tree: 274 of 4754 frames, 0.37 GB, with all 16 witness frames held. Wired into the console so that while deleting stays refused it still publishes what COULD be freed - because off and nothing-to-free must not look the same.
